tool_descriptions.shell: Run a shell command (zsh on macOS) and return its output. Quote paths with spaces. Prefer a dedicated tool when one fits. Large output is saved to a file and previewed. `timeout` is optional; background commands return at once and you are notified when they finish.
tool_descriptions.read: Read a file (text, image, or PDF) or list a directory. Text lines are prefixed `<line>: ` (1-based; not part of the file). For large files use offset and limit, preferring one larger read over many slices, or grep for the content.
tool_descriptions.question: Ask the user while you work: a preference, an unclear instruction, or a choice between approaches. A free-text answer is added automatically. `multiple: true` allows several picks. Put a recommended option first and end its label with "(Recommended)".
tool_descriptions.grep: Search file contents with a ripgrep regex or literal text, narrowed by `path` or `include`. Returns paths, line numbers, and previews.
tool_descriptions.webfetch: Fetch an HTTP(S) URL as markdown (default), text, or HTML. Read-only; prefer a more specific tool when one exists. Large results are previewed.
tool_descriptions.execute: Run JavaScript in the Code Mode runtime to call tools and combine their results. `fetch` works; imports, the filesystem, and timers do not. Call only tools listed in the Code Mode catalog or returned by `search`, by their exact path, keeping bracket notation such as `tools.ns["tool-name"](input)`. `return` the result (else the last expression is returned). Await calls that matter; run independent ones with `Promise.allSettled`.
tool_descriptions.patch:
Edit files with a patch:

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: <path>        then the contents, every line starting with +
*** Update File: <path>     optionally *** Move to: <new path>, then @@ hunks of -/+ lines
*** Delete File: <path>
*** End Patch

Every operation needs its header, and new lines always start with +. Example:

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/app.py
@@ def greet():
-print("Hi")
+print("Hello")
*** End Patch
tool_descriptions.edit: Replace exact text in a file. Copy indentation exactly from read output and leave out its `<line>: ` prefix. oldString must match exactly once unless replaceAll is true; add surrounding context to make it unique. Use replaceAll for every occurrence, such as a rename.
tool_descriptions.write: Create or overwrite a file; missing folders are created. For partial changes use edit.
